nodes.label: meal-plan Specification
nodes.description: Main OpenSpec spec for the meal-plan capability (created by archiving build-cooking-hub)

nodes.label: Week view (meal-plan)
nodes.description: `/plan?week=<monday>` SHALL show one week Monday–Sunday (default: the week containing today) with the slots Breakfast, Lunch, Dinner and Snacks per day, any number of entries per slot in position order, today highlighted (`data-today`), and the controls previous week, next week and "This week". Each empty slot SHALL show an add affordance. On phone the days SHALL be stacked vertically; at 1280 the
scenarios: Week query returns entries in day, slot and position order
Week shows Monday to Sunday with four slots
Today is highlighted
Previous, next and This week
Empty week shows add affordances
Phone stacks the days and desktop shows the grid

nodes.label: Plan entries (meal-plan)
nodes.description: An entry SHALL be either a recipe with servings (at least 1; default the recipe's servings) or a non-empty free text, added from a slot's add control (recipe picker with search, or free text) and appended at the end of the slot. scenarios: Empty free text is rejected
Servings below 1 are rejected in the plan
Entry servings and text can be edited
Add a recipe entry with the picker
Add a free-text entry
Empty free text shows an error
Edit and delete an entry

nodes.label: Moving entries (meal-plan)
nodes.description: On desktop a recipe SHALL be draggable from the recipe rail onto a slot (new entry, recipe servings), and entries SHALL be draggable between slots and days and to another position within a slot; the slot under the pointer SHALL be highlighted (`data-drop-target`). A drop outside any slot SHALL return the entry to its origin and save nothing. Every entry SHALL have a "Move to…" menu (day of the sho
scenarios: Moving an entry reorders the slot
Drag a recipe from the rail onto a slot
Drag an entry to another day
Reorder entries within a slot
Drop target is highlighted

nodes.label: Copy week (meal-plan)
nodes.description: "Copy week" SHALL copy every entry of a source week (default: the week before the shown one) into the shown week, same weekday and slot, appended after existing entries. A source week without entries SHALL report "Nothing to copy" and change nothing; if the shown week has entries, a confirm SHALL come first.
